'''Christian Lapidge Vapormatic 2000''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Christian Lapidge]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls104.htm Vapormatic 2000], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228055924/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls104.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Christian Lapidge]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
